title: Logic circuit simulator
description: Create switches, gates, and lights; wire a circuit and test its output in original BASIC.
versionOrder: Inferred from five consecutive tape15b saves. Later forms add device identification, initialization, reset, and truth-table functionality; source grows from 45 to 116 lines. Dates are not established. The latest complete save is the selected reference.
